notes:
# v1.4.18 - blocked sources can be unblocked from inside the app

- Fixed: sources that sit behind a Cloudflare browser check (mgeko, toonily,
  manhuatop, novelfull, royalroad, freewebnovel) used to look empty or partly
  empty - a search came back with "0 results" and a title opened with no
  chapters, even though the source has both. They now say that the source is
  blocked and offer a "Retry source" button, so the problem is visible instead
  of disguised as missing content.
- Fixed: passing that browser check once in the app's built-in browser now
  unlocks the source for every later request. The app keeps the access it
  earned and presents it exactly as the browser that earned it did, so search
  results, chapter lists and chapter pages all start working again without
  repeating the check each time.
- Fixed: covers from those sources now load too once the check has been passed,
  instead of staying as grey placeholders while the rest of the source works.
- Fixed: a source that genuinely fails upstream - an error page, a wrong
  response, a temporary outage - is no longer shown as a source with nothing
  in it. The app reports the actual failure, so "this source has no results"
  and "this source is not answering" can no longer be mistaken for each other.
- Fixed: fixing a blocked source no longer switches the app away from its
  built-in fallback source for everything else. The fallback used to be turned
  off app-wide the first time any source was blocked, which quietly made
  results worse on unrelated titles for the rest of the session.
- Fixed: a search that hits several blocked sources at once now runs the check
  once per source and continues, instead of pausing or retrying each source
  separately.
- Note: no action needed - just update. If a source still shows as blocked
  after updating, open it once from the button the app offers and it will stay
  unlocked for later searches, titles and chapters.
